digest.component_or_area: rebar reconciler / binding lifecycle integration test
propositions: The idempotency test patches binding_store._now_iso to freeze the clock, but the patch no longer reaches clear_absent and its siblings after they were moved to binding_lifecycle module during RP-02 S2 T2.
clear_absent and related absence/tombstone/comment operations now resolve _now_iso from binding_lifecycle rather than binding_store, so clock mocking must target both modules to catch regressions.
The integration oracle's blast radius narrowed after the refactoring: it would silently miss a regression that makes clear_absent stamp updated_at unconditionally on an unchanged pass.

Fixing the oracle requires patching _now_iso on both binding_store and binding_lifecycle modules (or introducing a single shared source) so the integration test fails if any binding operation timestamps an entry on a healthy no-churn pass.
